The plan before it changed

See the animals, then stroll the garden paths

Was

🌳 Historic Oak View County Park

4028 Carya Dr., Raleigh, NC 27610 · Raleigh

Arrive 9 am, leave by 11 am · Free · Outdoors

Your toddler can look for the animals and wander the garden and greenway paths. It is a slow, open-air morning with plenty of room to explore.

  • Let them lead the way and stop wherever they like.
  • Bring a snack and water so they can refuel before the walk back.
  • Say goodbye to the animals one by one, then head to the car for lunch before nap.

About Historic Oak View County Park

    Raleigh · 9:50 am–11 am

    Map · Museum admission is free · No sign-up needed
